definition: AI system deployment conditional on passing pre-deployment safety evaluation, verification, or certification before market release.
rationale_for_coinage: Safetyists see pre-deployment gating as essential — systems must be verified safe before release. Accelerationists frame it as a bureaucratic bottleneck slowing beneficial deployment. Skeptics worry the certification process itself may be captured by industry. The bare term 'deployment' conceals whether safety gates are required.

do_not_confuse_with.note: Competitive deployment prioritizes speed-to-market; gated deployment prioritizes pre-release verification.

contested_aspects: Whether pre-deployment gates can keep pace with rapid development cycles
Who should set and enforce deployment criteria
Whether post-deployment monitoring is a sufficient alternative
